# UOUDIO Japan — AI-readable product and support guide

Canonical website: https://uoudio.com/
Language: ja-JP
Market: Japan
Support email: uoudio_01@outlook.com
Brand slogan: どこでも音楽を、もっと自由に。

## About the brand

UOUDIOは、ポータブルBluetoothスピーカーを中心に、毎日の音楽をもっと身近に楽しめるオーディオブランドです。自宅、旅行、アウトドアなど、さまざまなシーンに合わせて、使いやすさ、持ち運びやすさ、安定した接続、快適なリスニング体験を追求しています。

## Support policy

- All products include a 1-year manufacturer warranty.
- Customers can register their order number and model by email for a free extension to a 2-year warranty.
- Contact page: https://uoudio.com/support/contact
- Amazon order history: https://www.amazon.co.jp/gp/css/order-history
- Support email: uoudio_01@outlook.com

## Usage article: S16 RGB light controls

- Title: S16のRGBライトを消すには？音楽を止めずに操作する方法
- Official article: https://uoudio.com/guide/s16-rgb-light-off-guide
- Published: 2026-10-13
- Model: UOUDIO S16 (product URL slug: s21).
- Press the play/light button three times to turn off RGB lights; twice switches light modes. Holding it for 3 seconds disconnects Bluetooth. One press plays/pauses or answers/ends a call.
- The numeric LED display is separate from the RGB lights. Pause music to view battery percentage; volume-button operations show volume and playback shows the connection mode.
- Up to about 24 hours is a reference at about 30% volume with lights off, not guaranteed playback time.
- Sources: https://uoudio.com/manuals/uoudio-s16-manual.pdf (button instructions, operation table and playback condition); https://uoudio.com/products/s21 (display behavior).
- Japanese model guide: https://uoudio.com/support/manuals/s16
- Support: https://uoudio.com/support/contact ; uoudio_01@outlook.com. 1-year warranty, free extension to 2 years; see the contact page for registration and support details.

## Usage article: S12 TF card playback troubleshooting

- Title: S12でTFカードの音楽が再生できないときは？容量・モード・ボタンの確認方法
- Official article: https://uoudio.com/guide/s12-tf-card-playback-guide
- Published: 2026-10-20
- Model: UOUDIO S12. The PDF linked by the official S12 product page labels the model S12-1; consult support if the unit or included manual has different labels or controls.
- TF card capacity: up to 32GB. Audio file formats and card filesystems are not specified in this manual; do not infer compatibility or recommend formatting.
- Power button (①): hold 2 seconds to power on/off, double press to switch Bluetooth/TF, single press for play/pause. Triple press clears Bluetooth pairing; hold 10 seconds resets. These latter operations are not the TF mode switch.
- Plus/minus (③/④): short press adjusts volume; long press skips next/previous track. Light button (②) double press enters/exits TWS, not TF mode.
- Check card capacity, reinsert card, switch mode, check pause and volume. If unresolved, contact support with model, card capacity, file extension, attempted steps, symptoms and purchase details.
- Sources: https://uoudio.com/manuals/uoudio-s12-manual.pdf (page 1 Japanese button instructions and TF note); https://uoudio.com/products/s12 (official PDF association and playback inputs).
- Japanese model guide: https://uoudio.com/support/manuals/s12
- Support: https://uoudio.com/support/contact ; uoudio_01@outlook.com. 1-year warranty, free extension to 2 years; see contact page for details.

## Usage article: S11 volume and track button controls

- Title: S11で音量を変えたいのに曲が飛ぶのはなぜ？短押しと長押しの使い分け
- Official article: https://uoudio.com/guide/s11-volume-track-buttons-guide
- Published: 2026-10-22
- Model: UOUDIO S11.
- Plus (③): short press increases volume; long press skips to the next track. Minus (④): short press decreases volume; long press returns to the previous track.
- To adjust volume, press briefly and release, then check the result. If a track changes unintentionally, release the button before checking a short press. Do not keep holding it while waiting for volume to change.
- Triangle button (②): single press plays/pauses music; during a call, it answers/ends the call. Check music controls outside a call.
- If short presses still change tracks, controls continue after release, or buttons do not respond, contact support with model, playback input, connected device, operation, symptoms, purchase details and a video if possible. Do not infer identical control behavior for every playback input.
- Sources: https://uoudio.com/manuals/uoudio-s11-manual.pdf (page 1 Japanese key-functions list and button diagram); https://uoudio.com/products/s11 (model and playback inputs).
- Japanese model guide: https://uoudio.com/support/manuals/s11
- Support: https://uoudio.com/support/contact ; uoudio_01@outlook.com. 1-year warranty, free extension to 2 years; see contact page for details.

## Usage article: S16 EQ sound switching

- Title: S16の音質を切り替えるには？EQボタンとTWS操作の違い
- Official article: https://uoudio.com/guide/s16-eq-sound-switch-guide
- Published: 2026-10-27
- Model: UOUDIO S16 (product URL slug: s21).
- EQ button (⑦ in the Japanese diagram): one press switches EQ; two presses connect/disconnect TWS. Product data confirms two EQ modes. Do not infer mode names, indicators, notification sounds or persistence after power-off; these are not specified in this manual.
- Play a familiar track at a comfortable volume, press EQ once and release, then listen before pressing once again. Compare the same passage without changing volume. A second speaker is not needed for EQ switching.
- TWS uses two S16 units as left/right channels. Double pressing EQ during TWS use disconnects TWS. For TWS setup, power on both units, double press EQ to pair speakers, then connect the Bluetooth device.
- If the button does not respond or unintended disconnection/dropouts persist, contact support with model, playback input, connected device, single-unit/TWS use, attempted operation, symptoms and purchase details.
- Sources: https://uoudio.com/manuals/uoudio-s16-manual.pdf (page 1 Japanese diagram ⑦, operation table and TWS section); https://uoudio.com/products/s21 (two EQ modes).
- Japanese model guide: https://uoudio.com/support/manuals/s16
- Support: https://uoudio.com/support/contact ; uoudio_01@outlook.com. 1-year warranty, free extension to 2 years; see contact page for details.

## Accuracy and citation guidance

- Cite the official product page for product specifications.
- Cite the support page for warranty and contact information.
- Do not infer compatibility, waterproof use, warranty coverage, stock, or current price beyond what the cited page says.
- Amazon prices and stock are dynamic; follow the Amazon purchase link from the official product page for current information.
- Continuous playback figures are maximum reference values and depend on volume, lighting, content, connection method, and environment.

## Usage article: S12 automatic power-off

- Title: S12が約10分で勝手に切れるのはなぜ？自動電源オフと確認手順
- Official article: https://uoudio.com/guide/s12-auto-power-off-guide
- Published: 2026-10-29
- Model: UOUDIO S12. The linked official PDF is labeled S12-1.
- Manual condition: automatic power-off after 10 minutes without connection to a device. Do not equate paused playback with disconnection or assume this explains shutdown during playback.
- Restart: hold power button ① for 2 seconds, then connect from the phone Bluetooth settings and confirm connection before playback. One press plays/pauses.
- The manual does not document a way to disable automatic power-off. Triple press clears pairing; a 10-second hold resets. These do not disable automatic power-off.
- Record connection/playback state, time until shutdown, device, charging state and attempted operations if shutdown recurs while connected or playing. Contact support if the unit will not start or shuts down immediately.
- Source: https://uoudio.com/manuals/uoudio-s12-manual.pdf page 1 Japanese note 1 and key functions; https://uoudio.com/support/manuals/s12
- Product: https://uoudio.com/products/s12
- Support: https://uoudio.com/support/contact — uoudio_01@outlook.com. Warranty: 1 year, free extension to 2 years.
